evidence.command: sudo -H mariadb --batch --raw --skip-column-names legacy_shop -e "SELECT 'orphan_orders', COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL; SELECT 'order_totals_and_items'; SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.total_cents, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0), COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents),0), COUNT(oi.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.total_cents ORDER BY o.order_id; SELECT 'order_total_mismatches', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.total_cents, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents),0) AS item_total FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.total_cents HAVING o.total_cents <> item_total OR item_total=0) AS mismatches; SELECT 'audit-types'; SELECT entity_type, COUNT(*) FROM audit_events GROUP BY entity_type ORDER BY entity_type; SELECT 'statuses-and-timestamps'; SELECT 'customers', status, COUNT(*), MIN(created_at), MAX(created_at) FROM customers GROUP BY status ORDER BY status; SELECT 'orders', status, COUNT(*), MIN(created_at), MAX(created_at) FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status; SELECT 'audit_events', action, COUNT(*), MIN(event_time), MAX(event_time) FROM audit_events GROUP BY action ORDER BY action;" 2>&1
